objective: Add a cached read-through endpoint for user profiles with a deterministic fallback path for store outages
in_scope: In-memory cache module with unit tests

shared_contracts.spec: GET /profiles/{id} returns 200 {id, name} for a known id or 404 {error: {code: 'not_found'}} for an unknown id
Cache: get(key) -> value|None; set(key, value, ttl_seconds) -> None; 60s default TTL; in-memory only

integration_seams.description: endpoint reads through the cache to the profile store; a cache hit must skip the store call

acceptance.description: GET /profiles/{id} returns 200 with body fields id and name for a known id, and 404 with error.code 'not_found' for an unknown id
acceptance.positive_case: a known profile id returns 200 with id and name fields
acceptance.negative_case: an unknown id returns 404 with error.code 'not_found'
acceptance.failure_behavior: a store outage returns 503 with error.code 'store_unavailable'
acceptance.evidence: pytest tests/api/test_profiles.py::test_get_known_200 and ::test_get_unknown_404 assert the status codes and body fields

acceptance.description: two consecutive GETs for the same id return 200 and the store is called exactly once across both requests
acceptance.positive_case: two consecutive GETs for the same id both return 200
acceptance.negative_case: different ids do not share a cache entry — the store is called once per id, asserted by a test
acceptance.failure_behavior: no failure behavior in this criterion — the store failure path is covered by A1, asserted by its test

open_questions.question: TTL value for the profile cache?
